newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 228 of August 19, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 228 of August 19, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EC) No 702/97 of 14 April 1997 opening and providing for the administration of autonomous Community tariff quotas for certain fishery products (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 104 of 22 April 1997)

Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EC) No 534/97 of 17 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1442/88 on the granting, for the 1988/1989 to 1997/1998 wine years, of permanent abandonment premiums in respect of wine-growing areas (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 83 of 25 March 1997)

COMMISSION DECISION of 13 August 1997 amending Decisions 97/515/EC, 97/513/EC, 97/516/EC and 97/517/EC concerning protective measures with regard to certain products of animal origin originating in India, Bangladesh and Madagascar (Text with EEA relevance) (97/553/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 11 August 1997 on marking and use of pigmeat in application of Article 9 of Council Directive 80/217/EEC concerning Belgium (Text with EEA relevance) (97/552/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 12 February 1997 on the compatibility with the common market of Germany's proposed extension of the investment-allowance and special-depreciation schemes to west Berlin, in so far as these schemes do not concern the agricultural products processing and marketing sector (Only the German text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) (97/551/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1644/97 of 18 August 1997 amending representative prices and additional duties for the import of certain products in the sugar sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1643/97 of 18 August 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1642/97 of 18 August 1997 determining the extent to which applications lodged in August 1997 for import certificates for certain cheeses covered by the arrangements provided for in the Europe Agreements concluded by the Community with Bulgaria and Romania can be accepted

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1641/97 of 18 August 1997 determining the extent to which applications lodged in August 1997 for import licences for certain milk products and products covered by the arrangements provided for in the Europe Agreements concluded by the Community with the Republic of Poland, the Republic of Hungary, the Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic can be accepted END OF DOCUMENT.
